definitions: To present (someone or something) to another for the first time.
To bring (something) into use or operation for the first time.
To make (something) known for the first time.
To precede with a preliminary section or statement.
examples: Let me introduce you to my colleague.
The company plans to introduce a new product next quarter.
He introduced a new concept to the team.
She introduced the needle into the fabric.
The speaker introduced her topic with a brief anecdote.
